sign_positivity.Gamma_positive: DM-to-vacuum flow; for rho_x>0, H>0 and past a<=1, the integral term in the CDM bracket is positive.
sign_positivity.Gamma_negative: Vacuum-to-DM forward; backward integral reduces the CDM bracket and can produce rho_c<=0.
sign_positivity.warning: The sign of the explicit delta_c source alone is not a full perturbative stability test.
